open_points.subject: R0-89 restore recovery point
open_points.text: The restored store begins its own history from the backup: every change after it is lost
open_points.question: Which changes are lost: changes committed after the backup snapshot, changes made after the store was lost, or some other interval?
options: All changes committed after the restored backup's snapshot
Only changes attempted after the store loss
Changes after the last successfully checked backup, even if a different backup is restored
open_points.default_guess: All changes committed after the restored backup's snapshot are lost.

open_points.subject: R0-89 retention-review recovery record
open_points.text: What the owner repeats after a restore — erasures, restrictions, ends of a relationship, the latest date audit entries were erased by — follows the owner's record of the retention review
open_points.question: Exactly which transitions must the record contain and the owner repeat, including lifting restrictions, resuming relationships, project anonymisation or deletion, and repeated or superseding actions?
options: Only the forward actions explicitly listed
Every retention-related transition, including lift and resume
Every Registry state change after the backup
open_points.default_guess: Record and replay every retention-related transition in its original order, including lift and resume.

open_points.subject: R0-89 retention-review record fields
open_points.text: naming each action by its date, kind and the `customer_ref` or `project_id` it touched
open_points.question: How is an audit-entry erasure recorded when it touches neither a customer nor a project, and does its cutoff date replace the required entity identifier?
options: Allow no entity identifier and record the audit cutoff date
Require a synthetic project or customer identifier
Do not include audit-entry erasure in this record
open_points.default_guess: Allow the entity identifier to be absent for audit erasure and record its cutoff date instead.

open_points.subject: R0-89 missing recovery records
open_points.text: Where either record is missing, what the restored store holds stands until the owner corrects it.
open_points.question: What are the two records meant by "either record": the export and import choices separately, an import-recovery bundle and the retention-review record, or something else?
options: The import-recovery bundle and the retention-review record
The export file and the import choices
open_points.default_guess: The two logical records are the import-recovery bundle and the retention-review record.

open_points.subject: R0-89 vault copy of personal data
open_points.text: The kept export and the import's choices hold personal data: the owner keeps them in the vault (R0-23)
open_points.question: Is the R0-23 Bitwarden vault permitted and technically able to hold these files, where is it hosted, and does any vault operator or provider become a recipient of the personal data?
options: An owner-controlled local vault with file storage
A hosted Bitwarden vault whose provider is an external recipient
A separate encrypted file vault not identified in the text
open_points.default_guess: Use an owner-controlled encrypted vault capable of storing files, with no third-party operator able to read them.
